clusters.name: codexu-surface
clusters.executionModeRationale: One serial cluster in the codexu-primary checkout. US-001 (insert define-first glossary) must precede US-002 (rename system references in the body) on AGENTS.md; US-003 (additive roadmap* npm aliases) is independent and folds in. codexu-surface edits AGENTS.md PROSE only; it does NOT touch the active-plugin-versions table (that is ship-coordination's). No submodule/contract dependency, so this runs in PARALLEL with toolkit-surface (different repo, git-index-disjoint).

clusters.name: toolkit-surface
clusters.executionModeRationale: One serial cluster inside an ai-developer-toolkit submodule worktree; file-disjoint from codexu-surface (different repo) so it runs in parallel. Define-first (US-005 viewer block) precedes the US-005 viewer-text/a11y rename + the asserting viewer tests. THIS cluster OWNS the plugin version bump (CHANGELOG + all 3 plugin manifests + 3 marketplace indexes) as its final ship step. US-006 (type aliases low-risk; MCP dual-register + data-dir fallback higher-risk, recommend DEFER) and US-004's template edit (consumer-ralph-overview.mjs + its test) are OPTIONAL (Q4) and depend on US-005; US-004's regenerated codexu bin/ralph-overview.mjs is recorded by ship-coordination. MUST SERIALIZE at ship with the sibling task ralph-overview-create-task-skill (same plugin).

clusters.name: ship-coordination
clusters.executionModeRationale: Runs AFTER both surface clusters, in the codexu-primary checkout. It records ONLY the codexu side in ONE commit: the ai-developer-toolkit submodule gitlink (pointer) bump + the codexu AGENTS.md active-plugin-versions table set to the version toolkit-surface already bumped (it does NOT re-bump plugin manifests/indexes/CHANGELOG) + the regenerated bin/ralph-overview.mjs if US-004 (Q4) landed. Touches AGENTS.md (also edited as prose by codexu-surface) so it must run after codexu-surface; the cross-repo pointer + version-table lockstep gates the CI invariant, so it cannot parallelize with the surface clusters. US-004 appears here (codexu wrapper regen) and in toolkit-surface (template edit) — it is a single optional feature split across the two repos.
